svg.text: Turn Sim: what talks to what (overview). Code as on main 051ddaf; Turn Sim files unchanged since 6a5ea29
Arrows carry the data named on them. Red dashed boxes are dead code (nothing imports them). The red arrows are an import loop. Numbers in brackets are lines (wc -l).
SHARED CORE src/core/ (pure maths; the Traffic thread owns it for now)
turn degrees, run length, box, rear
ct156-model: used by layout and views
Setup, errors, settings menu, Profiles placeholder,
bar, Layers menu, Formation card. Hides boxes by
timing / formation / turn. Keeps no state.
owns scenario (81 keys) and layout (17 keys)
makes ONE createRun; frame loop in fixed 0.05 s steps,
at most 40 a frame; trails (60 s), breadcrumbs, bank signs;
2D/3D switch, keys, clean-up. ANY scenario change ->
Lead-frame snapshot -> TIGHT / WIDE / FORE / AFT,
flags, turn numbers, cue / cross / check / box notes
grid, trails, 3/9 line, spacing lines, circles, aircraft
loaded on first use; flat at height 0
labels, units, hints; buildField() makes a ui-kit control
81 keys, DEFAULTS, rules, turn checks, migration.
No imports. Read by layout, fields, index, run, formation.
reset / step / startLeg; plans at the FIRST step;
publishes state; keeps history rows; makes preview runs
for crossings. The only engine file index.js calls.
who turns, which way, how far, WHEN; box slots,
Delayed 45 check: pre-flies copies of two aircraft
one 0.05 s step: turn at the core rate if its time or
cue has come, then move straight; G fix/lag/lead (V6)
start slots for 4 formations, start-position errors
clock-position cue test, Auto position, status lines
box rear element: out, hold, back
registry loads index.js and passes app;
Colours: purple user controls, blue screen files, orange engine files, green shared core, grey storage/shell/ui-kit.
